en.ammaar-muslim: 3. [3/90] al-Kafi: Ali b. Ibrahim from his father from Hammad b. Isa from Ibrahim b. Umar al-Yamani from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام, he said:
I asked him about the words of Allah Mighty and Majestic: “two just men among you” [5:95]
he said: the just man is the messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله and the Imam after him,
then he said: this is among that which the scribes made a mistake in.
